blurb: Fort Ouest offers outdoor paintball, airsoft, and Grab or Tag games on large outdoor fields near Mont-Tremblant. Guests participate in team missions using paintball markers or airsoft equipment, or play Grab or Tag with soft balls and flags. The site operates year-round with facilities for regrouping between games and offers equipment rental and game facilitation.
